✅ Correct Answer: B — Stefan Johansson

📖 Explanation:

Stefan Johansson claimed a sensational third-place finish at the 1989 Portuguese Grand Prix at Estoril, starting from 12th on the grid in his Onyx ORE-1.

Johansson famously completed the entire 71-lap race without making a single tyre stop, nursing his Goodyear tyres to cross the line behind winner Gerhard Berger and Alain Prost.

This historic result marked the first and only podium finish for the cash-strapped Onyx Grand Prix team before they folded midway through the 1990 season.
